import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
        int m0 = m, t, q;
        int x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        while (a > 1) {
            q = a / m;
            t = m;
            m = a % m;
            a = t;
            t = x0;
            x0 = x1 - q * x0;
            x1 = t;
        }
        if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
        return x1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] p = new int[n][n];
        int inv100 = modInverse(100, MOD);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (int)((long)val * inv100 % MOD);
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> sizeGroups = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> subsetList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int sz = 0; sz <= n; sz++) {
            sizeGroups.add(new ArrayList<>());
            subsetList.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        for (int sz = 0; sz <= n; sz++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); s++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(s) == sz) {
                    sizeGroups.get(sz).add(s);
                    subsetList.get(sz).add(s);
                }
            }
        }

        Map<Long, Integer>[] dp = new HashMap[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
        dp[0].put(1L, 1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < (1 << n); s++) {
                long prod = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (((s >> j) & 1) == 1)
                        prod = (prod * p[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
                    else
                        prod = (prod * (1 + MOD - p[i - 1][j])) % MOD;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Integer> entry : dp[i - 1].entrySet()) {
                    long f = entry.getKey();
                    int count = entry.getValue();
                    long mask = 0;
                    for (int t : subsetList.get(i)) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                            if (((t >> j) & 1) == 1 && ((s >> j) & 1) == 1 && (((f >> sizeGroups.get(i - 1).indexOf(t ^ (1 << j))) & 1) == 1)) {
                                mask |= 1L << sizeGroups.get(i).indexOf(t);
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    dp[i].put(mask, (int)((dp[i].getOrDefault(mask, 0) + (long)count * prod) % MOD));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n].getOrDefault(1L, 0));
    }
}
